note: Rewritten from the new-species description in Emerson 1960 (American Museum Novitates No. 1988); the original is in English. Only the soldier is described; the alate and the worker are not described (the worker is recorded only as part of the type material). The measurements are taken from table 11 of that work, the two columns giving the holotype and the range of paratypes from the type colony: head length with mandibles 3.69 in the holotype, with no paratype range; the OCR of the holotype head thickness lost the decimal point and reads "122", which is judged to be 1.22 from the paratype range 1.18—1.30; the holotype hind tibia length is OCR'd as "Tae" and is unreadable, so only the paratype range 1.19—1.35 is recorded, without guessing. Type material: 6 soldiers (holotype and paratypes) and workers, from Camp Putnam on the Epulu River, Congo (Kinshasa) (1°24′N, 28°36′E), 1948-05-14, in an abandoned surface carton nest, together with Microtermes and Microcerotermes in the same nest. The synonymy list, the explanation of plates and the other species mentioned in the comparison sentence (F. soyeri, F. longilabius, F. winifredae, F. brevimalatus) are not recorded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: It differs from the other known species of the genus in the size of the labrum and in the spread lateral lobes of the labrum with the lateral margins relatively gently curved.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head in dorsal view with the sides only slightly narrowed forwards; vertex slightly concave in lateral view. Antennae 14 or 15-segmented. Labrum short, the lateral lobes spread and rather narrow, the lateral margins slightly curved. Outer margin of the mandibles fairly evenly convex, the elbow-like bend very inconspicuous. Anterior margin of the pronotum with a distinct notch. Measurements (mm; holotype, paratype range from the type colony in parentheses): head length with mandibles 3.69 (holotype only); head length to the mandibular base 1.76 (1.70—1.91); head length to the tip of the frontal projection 1.68 (1.65—1.77); head width 1.57 (1.49—1.59); head thickness including the postmentum 1.22 (1.18—1.30); median length of the postmentum 0.87 (0.83—0.92); maximum width of the postmentum 0.46 (0.45—0.50); minimum width of the postmentum 0.33 (0.32—0.36); median length of the labrum 0.18 (0.18—0.20); length of the lateral lobe of the labrum from the base 0.79 (0.84—0.90); length of the left mandible 1.98 (1.88—2.06); length of the left mandible from the tooth to the tip 1.08 (1.04—1.09); pronotum length 0.37 (0.35—0.39), width 0.80 (0.77—0.84); hind tibia length unreadable in the holotype, 1.19—1.35 in the paratypes.
